instruction.name: xvdiv.hu
instruction.description: Divide each unsigned 16-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element in `b`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4

latencies.notes: xj -> result chain. The measured operand pair is a sample; the range comes from the operand sweep recorded for this instruction.

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr8, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr16, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr9, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr17, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr10, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr18, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr11, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr19, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr12, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr20, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr13, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr21, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr14, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr22, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr15, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr23, $r4' --asm 'xvdiv.hu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvdiv.hu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvdiv.hu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvdiv.hu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvdiv.hu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvdiv.hu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvdiv.hu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvdiv.hu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23'
throughput.notes: Range over the same pairs: min CPI 7.50 at 0/1, max CPI 21.50 at 65535/1. Sample uses 1/1.

notes: LASX variable-latency integer divide/modulo. Latency uses an element-0 reset helper; throughput uses 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover positive operands including powers of two and max values. Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
